legal_standard: FACT = primary/on-record in corpus (statute, registry, Health Canada via site corpus, CBC/CRA/FITR public pages). REPORTING = journalism / secondary named sources in corpus. SOCIAL_SIGNAL = public posts cited in vaults. INFERENCE = ranked collection priority / 5GW frame — not conspiracy finding.
disclaimer: Priority nodes are OSINT collection priorities for accountability journalism. Inclusion is not a criminal finding.

Domain-C (foreign FI) is structurally real per Hogue but collection-starved until FITR opens 2026-08-04 and NSICOP names stay classified. Highest falsifiability×impact residuals are hard video vault (cutaway), MAID voice-ratio N≥100, and EC/OIC public records — not more social pile-on.
